title: Performance_II_
description: A simple modpack full of Mods that make your game run smoother
body:
## ⚡ Performance+ Vanilla Modpack

More FPS. Smoother gameplay. 

---

### 🚀 What this modpack does

* Significantly **higher FPS & stable performance**
* All important **settings are already optimized**
* Runs great even on **lower-end PCs**

---

### 🎮 Vanilla, but better

* Stays **close to the vanilla feeling**
* No overloaded content mods
* Perfect as a **clean base**

---

### 🔧 Make it your own

* Easily **add your own mods**
* Ideal for your **personal setup**
* Flexible & easy to expand

---

### 👥 Multiplayer ready

* Perfect for **playing with friends**
* Includes mods that improve multiplayer experience

---

### 🌅 Shaders included

* Selection of **different shaders**
* For **low-end PCs** (more FPS)
* For **high-end PCs** (better visuals)

---

### 💡 In short

A lightweight, optimized modpack that gives you **better performance** without changing Minecraft too much — while still letting you fully customize your experience.
